description: A flagged item cannot be approved until the user explicitly reviews the flag and overrides it. Passing items approve directly.
name: critic-gate
note: Slice 3: runs as code in app/page.js via canApprove (lib/crew.js). A card with critic verdict flag shows the blocker and a checkbox ('I reviewed the flag and approve anyway'); the Approve button appears only after the override is ticked. The override is page-state only and is not persisted.
steps: Critic verdict pass: approve button enabled directly
Critic verdict flag: approval blocked, override checkbox shown
Override ticked: approve button enabled for that item only
